caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden-cased clock with a reddish-brown hue and a polished finish. The clock features ornate gold finials on the top corners and central crest, with an undulating decorative element connecting the finials and forming a symmetrical design. The clock's upper section contains a round white clock face with black Arabic numerals and black clock hands, encircled by a gold border. Below the clock face, there is a glass panel divided into two sections: the upper part has a decorative design with gold florals on a dark background, while the larger, lower part depicts a painted rural scene. This scene shows a light blue and white building with columns on the left, greenery, trees, a path, and an oval opening bordered with small dots or pearls in the center. The entire clock rests on four short, curved legs. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Shelf Clock
